_source: Official USCIS "Civics Questions and Answers (2008 version)", rev. 08/21, downloaded from uscis.gov and parsed verbatim. Questions and answers are USCIS wording, not rewritten.
_whoTakesThis: Applicants who filed Form N-400 BEFORE 20 October 2025 take this 2008 test. Those filing on or after that date take the 2025 test, which has 128 questions and a different pass mark.
_format: The officer asks up to 10 of the 100 questions orally. Six correct out of ten passes.
_variable: Nine answers are not fixed. Four vary by where you live (20, 23, 43, 44) and five change with elections or appointments (28, 29, 39, 46, 47). USCIS does not print those answers either; it directs applicants to uscis.gov/citizenship/testupdates. This app asks you to fill them in rather than showing a name that may be out of date.
_capitals: State capitals are static, so those are filled in for you from the place picker. Senators, Representative and Governor are not, so you enter them.

places.name: District of Columbia
places.note: D.C. is not a state. It has no U.S. Senators, no Governor, and no state capital. USCIS accepts those answers.

places.note: A U.S. territory. No U.S. Senators. It has a Governor and a Resident Commissioner rather than a voting Representative.
